card.situation:
S--CHRI Custodial Services (FY27): a Total Small Business Set-Aside solicitation from the National Park Service for 12 months of custodial services at Christiansted National Historic Site, St. Croix, USVI (NAICS 561720).
Reached the owner because Red Cedar qualifies as a small business under NAICS 561720 and the set-aside is compatible with the firm's eligible set-aside list.
reasons_for: NAICS 561720 exact match and total small business set-aside eligibility are fully satisfied, clearing the baseline eligibility gate. [6d5f0cc8-9f5dba22-p8-146174bb]

Three directly relevant federal custodial past-performance references (Oklahoma City Federal Building, VA outpatient clinic, state office complex) satisfy the solicitation's three-reference requirement. [6d5f0cc8-9f5dba22-p8-4e2b063d]

The 12-month base period satisfies the owner's rc-base rule, and the firm's FFP pricing experience (GSA Region 7 at $1.24M, VA at $420K) supports a compliant price structure. [6d5f0cc8-749bcf90-p2-368f835a]
reasons_against: HARD OWNER RULE VIOLATION: Christiansted NHS is in St. Croix, USVI — over 2,000 miles from Oklahoma City — far exceeding the firm's 200-mile bid limit, making this a mandatory no-bid. [profile: rc-distance rule]
The solicitation deadline has already passed (days_to_close = -5.6); a timely quotation cannot be submitted regardless of any other factor. [6d5f0cc8-9f5dba22-p3-667436fa]

The firm has no USVI workforce or operational presence, making it operationally infeasible to place an employee on-site by 7:00 AM daily or provide a qualified same-day replacement by 9:00 AM from Oklahoma City. [6d5f0cc8-749bcf90-p2-026c2451; 6d5f0cc8-749bcf90-p2-9e699ab2]

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB/EDWOSB) qualified under NAICS 561720 – Janitorial Services, with active federal custodial contracts supporting GSA Region 7 and the Department of Veterans Affairs. We self-perform all work using 38 W-2 employees supervised by OSHA 30-certified leads.

Our core capabilities directly address the CHRI Statement of Work:

• Interior and exterior custodial services for federal public-use, restroom, office, and grounds areas — demonstrated at the Oklahoma City Federal Building ($1.24M FFP) and a VA outpatient clinic ($420K FFP).
• Grounds maintenance including litter removal, walkway clearing, and debris collection, as performed at a cantonment area grounds contract.
• Green cleaning program using environmentally approved products, aligned with the park's environmentally friendly cleaning requirement.
• CIMS-GB certification and CMMS-based quality control inspections with documented daily logs and weekly reporting.
• PPE provision and closed-toe footwear enforcement consistent with OSHA safety standards.
• Firm-fixed-price contract experience with structured timekeeping, COR communication, and supply inventory monitoring via CMMS.

Three relevant past-performance references under NAICS 561720 are available upon request: custodial services at a federal office building, housekeeping support at an outpatient clinic, and janitorial services at a state office complex.

Red Cedar is registered with e-Verify and maintains compliance with applicable wage determinations. We welcome the opportunity to discuss our technical approach with the Contracting Officer.
questions_for_co: Historic surface protection protocols: The SOW requires cleaning that protects masonry, limewash, woodwork, and historic architectural features [6d5f0cc8-749bcf90-p4-38485d28]. Will the Government provide a list of approved cleaning products or application methods for each historic surface type, or is the contractor expected to propose its own preservation-compliant protocol for CO/COR approval prior to performance?

Same-day replacement feasibility: The SOW requires a qualified replacement employee on-site no later than 9:00 AM on any day of absence [6d5f0cc8-749bcf90-p2-9e699ab2]. Given the remote island location of CHRI in St. Croix, USVI, does the Government anticipate that offerors will maintain a local bench of qualified employees on St. Croix, and is there a local labor pool or incumbent workforce the contractor may draw from?

Monument and artifact cleaning restrictions: The SOW states the contractor shall not clean, modify, or apply chemicals to the monument itself [6d5f0cc8-749bcf90-p3-3d81d4e4]. Can the CO identify which specific structures or features are designated 'monuments' for this purpose, and will a site orientation or NPS preservation briefing be provided to the contractor before performance begins?

Liability insurance acceptability: The SOW requires liability insurance of at least $500,000 per occurrence and $500,000 property damage, in a form satisfactory to the Contracting Officer [6d5f0cc8-9f5dba22-p10-0f12f7ba; 6d5f0cc8-9f5dba22-p10-eeb7e358]. Will the CO confirm whether a standard commercial general liability (CGL) policy from an A.M. Best-rated carrier is acceptable, and whether a certificate of insurance is required at time of quote submission or only at award?

SAM registration and UEI confirmation timing: The solicitation requires active SAM registration at time of quote submission, at award, and throughout performance, and a valid UEI [6d5f0cc8-9f5dba22-p3-e56f5f3c; 6d5f0cc8-9f5dba22-p8-8fc1c5af]. Will the CO confirm whether SAM registration and UEI must be verified and active as of the September 8, 2026 quote deadline, and whether an offeror whose SAM registration is in a renewal/pending status at submission will be considered?

IPP enrollment and electronic payment: The SOW requires the contractor to register and submit all payment requests through the IPP website [6d5f0cc8-9f5dba22-p9-d300a00d; 6d5f0cc8-9f5dba22-p9-bc72171d]. Can the CO confirm the specific IPP agency portal (DOI/NPS) the contractor must enroll in, and whether IPP enrollment must be completed prior to award or may be completed within a specified number of days after award?

reader.scope_summary: The government is buying custodial services for facilities and grounds located within Christiansted National Historic Site (CHRI), a highly visited historic district that must be maintained in a clean, safe, and visitor-ready condition at all times. The contractor shall provide custodial services necessary to maintain interior and exterior public-use, operational, restroom, office, museum, exhibit, support, and grounds areas throughout the site, furnishing all labor, supervision, communication devices, contractor-provided equipment, PPE, and management. The contract period is twelve (12) months, with work performed Monday through Friday between 7:00 AM and 4:00 PM, and the contractor must use only approved environmentally friendly cleaning products and protect historic surfaces including masonry, limewash, woodwork, and historic architectural features.
reader.evaluation_basis: The Government will evaluate quotes and make award to the responsible offeror whose quotation represents the best value to the Government. Factor 1 is Technical Capability/Approach, under which the Government will evaluate the offeror's understanding of the custodial requirement and the feasibility of its approach to performing the Statement of Work. Offerors must qualify as a small business under NAICS 561720 - Janitorial Services.
reader.incumbent_or_history: Question 8 in Attachment 0004 asks: "Please confirm whether there is an incumbent service employee and, if so, whether any length of service must be recognized for vacation benefits under the applicable wage determination." No government response to that question is recorded in the provided text; no incumbent contractor is named and no prior award details are stated.

These structures, along with surrounding grounds such as the David Hamilton Jackson Park area, form a highly visited historic district that must be maintained in a clean, safe, and visitor-ready condition at all times.

Supply Inventory The contractor shall maintain a minimum 45-day supply of cleaning supplies & materials on site and notify the COR when supply levels reach approximately 45 days remaining so that additional supplies can be ordered.
If the assigned employee is absent due to illness, leave, resignation, or other circumstances, the contractor shall provide a qualified replacement employee no later than 9:00 AM on that day.

matrix.evidence: Past performance: Custodial services, Oklahoma City Federal Building ($1,240,000 FFP); Housekeeping support, outpatient clinic ($420,000).

matrix.quote: The Contractor shall procure and maintain during the term of this contract and any extension thereof liability insurance in form satisfactory to the Contracting Officer by an insurance company which is acceptable to the Contracting Officer.
matrix.firm_answer: Firm profile does not mention liability insurance coverage.
matrix.evidence: Firm profile is silent on insurance; no certificate or coverage levels stated.

matrix.quote: The amounts of the insurance shall be not less than as follows: $100,000.00 each person $500,000.00 each occurrence $500,000.00 property damage
matrix.firm_answer: No insurance coverage amounts are stated in the firm profile.
matrix.evidence: Firm profile does not reference liability insurance minimums or current coverage.

matrix.quote: A contractor employee shall be present and working no later than 7:00 AM each workday and remain until 4:00 PM.
matrix.firm_answer: Firm has 38 W-2 employees and experience with structured daily schedules, but has no workforce or presence in St. Croix, USVI to fulfill this requirement.
matrix.evidence: Firm profile: 38 W-2 employees, Oklahoma City, OK. No USVI presence or remote deployment capability stated.

matrix.quote: Timekeeping Requirement The contractor shall maintain a timekeeping system documenting employee arrival and departure each workday.
matrix.firm_answer: Firm uses a CMMS for QC logging; timekeeping capability is consistent with this system.
matrix.evidence: Capabilities: QC inspections logged in a CMMS.

matrix.quote: Restroom Cleaning Requirements Restrooms shall be maintained in a sanitary condition throughout the day.
matrix.firm_answer: Firm has demonstrated restroom cleaning in federal building and clinic past performance.
matrix.evidence: Past performance: Custodial services, Oklahoma City Federal Building (keywords: restrooms); Housekeeping support, outpatient clinic (keywords: infection control, terminal cleaning).

matrix.quote: Exterior Cleaning and Grounds Maintenance Exterior areas including walkways, gathering areas, and circulation areas shall be maintained free of litter and debris.
matrix.firm_answer: Firm provides grounds maintenance including mowing, trimming, and debris removal per capabilities and Tinker AFB past performance.
matrix.evidence: Capabilities: grounds maintenance (mowing, trimming). Past performance: Grounds maintenance, cantonment area (keywords: grounds, mowing, trimming).

matrix.quote: Safety Requirements Contractor employees must wear closed-toe footwear such as boots or tennis shoes.
matrix.firm_answer: Firm has OSHA 30 supervisors and PPE capability; closed-toe footwear is a standard safety requirement consistent with firm's safety posture.
matrix.evidence: Capabilities: OSHA 30 supervisors, contractor shall supply appropriate PPE.

matrix.quote: The contractor shall supply appropriate PPE required to safely perform custodial duties.
matrix.firm_answer: Firm explicitly lists PPE provision in its capabilities.
matrix.evidence: Capabilities: personal protective equipment (PPE) listed as contractor-furnished.

matrix.quote: Quotations shall be evaluated in an impartial manner.
matrix.firm_answer: Informational clause; no firm action required.
matrix.evidence: No firm-specific action required; standard FAR evaluation language.

matrix.quote: The Contractor must use the IPP website to register access and use IPP for submitting requests for payment.
matrix.firm_answer: IPP registration is not mentioned in the firm profile, but it is a standard federal invoicing requirement compatible with the firm's federal contracting history.
matrix.evidence: Firm profile does not reference IPP; however, firm has prior federal contracts (GSA, VA) suggesting familiarity.

matrix.quote: The period of performance shall be twelve (12) months from the date of award, unless otherwise stated in the award document.
matrix.firm_answer: 12-month base period satisfies owner rule [rc-base].
matrix.evidence: Owner rule [rc-base]: no bids under a 12-month base period. This contract is exactly 12 months.

matrix.quote: These structures, along with surrounding grounds such as the David Hamilton Jackson Park area, form a highly visited historic district that must be maintained in a clean, safe, and visitor-ready condition at all times.
matrix.firm_answer: Firm has no demonstrated experience maintaining a historic district or high-visitation NPS site. Federal building and clinic experience is relevant but not equivalent.
matrix.evidence: Past performance: Custodial services, Oklahoma City Federal Building; Housekeeping support, outpatient clinic. No NPS or historic district experience listed.

matrix.quote: The contractor shall not clean, modify, or apply chemicals to the monument itself.
matrix.firm_answer: Firm profile does not address monument or historic artifact handling protocols.
matrix.evidence: Firm profile is silent on monument or historic artifact restrictions; no NPS experience listed.

matrix.quote: Offerors shall review Attachment 0004 and all prior solicitation documents when preparing their quotations.
matrix.firm_answer: Standard submission requirement; firm would need to review all attachments including Q&A II before preparing a quote.
matrix.evidence: Standard procedural requirement; no firm-specific capability gap.

matrix.quote: Any assumption used in developing the technical approach, staffing, schedule, pricing, or any other portion of the quotation must be clearly identified in the quote package.
matrix.firm_answer: Standard submission requirement; firm would need to document assumptions, particularly around USVI logistics and staffing.
matrix.evidence: Standard procedural requirement; firm has prior federal quote experience.

matrix.quote: The contractor employee must remain on site during the full duty period unless otherwise authorized by the COR.
matrix.firm_answer: Firm has no workforce in St. Croix, USVI. Deploying and retaining an employee on-site full-time from Oklahoma City is operationally infeasible without a local presence.
matrix.evidence: Firm profile: all employees and operations based in Oklahoma City, OK and neighboring states. No USVI presence.

matrix.quote: However, additional staffing must be approved in writing by the COR and the contract price shall remain unchanged regardless of the number of contractor employees utilized.
matrix.firm_answer: Firm has 38 W-2 employees and experience with fixed-price contracts. Compliance with fixed-price staffing flexibility is within firm's capability.
matrix.evidence: Past performance: Custodial services, Oklahoma City Federal Building ($1,240,000 FFP); firm has managed multi-employee custodial contracts.

matrix.quote: Payment requests must be submitted electronically through the U.
matrix.firm_answer: Electronic invoicing is standard for federal contractors; firm has prior federal contracts suggesting this capability.
matrix.evidence: Firm profile does not explicitly reference electronic invoicing or IPP, but prior federal contracts (GSA, VA) imply familiarity.

matrix.quote: Government Response: The contractor will not be provided with keys; instead, combination locks have been installed for areas the contractor is authorized to access.
matrix.firm_answer: Firm profile does not address access control procedures, but combination lock access is a standard operational accommodation.
matrix.evidence: Firm profile is silent on access control methods; no specific capability gap identified.

matrix.quote: Trash Collection The contractor shall collect trash from interior and exterior areas.
matrix.firm_answer: Firm has demonstrated trash and recycling collection in federal building past performance.
matrix.evidence: Past performance: Custodial services, Oklahoma City Federal Building (keywords: trash, recycling).

matrix.quote: Contractor employees may clean surfaces only and shall not move documents, evidence, or official materials.
matrix.firm_answer: Standard custodial restriction; consistent with firm's federal building and government office experience.
matrix.evidence: Past performance: Custodial services, Oklahoma City Federal Building; Janitorial, state office complex — both involve government document environments.
